title: Ben and the Pigeon Parade
synopsis: Ben takes the green bus with Amy and discovers that Market Street’s pigeons have no interest in marching in his parade.
continuity_state: Before: Amy and Wendy have ridden the green bus from beyond Far Meadow to Market Street. Ben has red scarf and wibble-wave; the market has a pigeon bench. After: Ben and his grown-up, with Amy and Grandma May, travel by the established green bus, watch pigeons from the square bench and invent a short silly pretend parade on the pavement, without chasing or feeding birds. Ben is familiar with the bus and square, and the story ends with him at home, still owning his red scarf. No object is left in Market Street.
